messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 3(14)

(14) ‘essential health and safety requirements’ means the mandatory provisions, set out in Annex III, relating to the design and construction of products within the scope of this Regulation to ensure a high level of protection of the health and safety of persons, and, where appropriate, domestic animals and property, and, where applicable, of the environment;

response.text:
essential health and safety requirements | are | mandatory provisions set out in Annex III | | the mandatory provisions, set out in Annex III, relating to the design and construction of products
essential health and safety requirements | relateTo | design and construction of products within the scope of this Regulation | | relating to the design and construction of products within the scope of this Regulation
essential health and safety requirements | aimTo | ensure a high level of protection of the health and safety of persons | | to ensure a high level of protection of the health and safety of persons
essential health and safety requirements | extendProtectionTo | domestic animals and property | where appropriate | and, where appropriate, domestic animals and property
essential health and safety requirements | extendProtectionTo | the environment | where applicable | and, where applicable, of the environment
